ns2:section.sectionText: Students are coached in ensemble preparation and performance on electric violins/violas/cellos/upright basses. Ensembles may range from duo to electric orchestra. Instructor and students jointly discuss and choose repertoire, with all styles of music taken into consideration. Numerous venues on and off campus provide performances opportunities. Consent of instructor required. Email: rlhaken@illinois.edu for authorization to enroll.
